directory_policies.notes.2: GRE policy: Khoury MS admission is GRE test-optional.
directory_policies.notes.3: GPA policy: Published minimums are 3.0/4, 8.0/10 and 80/100. Calculation scope and supported scales need review; no linear GPA conversion is performed.
directory_policies.notes.4: English policy: TOEFL 90 and IELTS 6.5 are recommended, not labelled hard minimums here. DET is not accepted. Four-year degree waiver paths require individual review.
directory_policies.notes.5: Deadlines: Fall 2027 international deadlines differ by location: June 15 out of country and July 1 in country. The current profile does not collect that location, so a single final deadline is not assumed.

fact_summary: Khoury MS admission distinguishes optional GRE, multiple GPA scales, recommended English scores and location-specific international deadlines.
